newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: FORECAST-Portugal spreads vs Bonos, Bunds.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-Portugal spreads vs Bonos, Bunds.

text.p: Following is the daily forecast for spreads in the Portuguese bond market based on a poll of five banks.
Poll covers spreads between the February 2007 Portuguese cash bond (OT) and the German and Spanish equivalents, together with the spreads between the Portuguese 10 and two-year bonds.
Min spread Avge Max vs previous close
Key factors likely to affect market:

- 10-year bonds seen well-supported with yield spreads against Bunds expected to remain at slightly above 50 basis points (bp). Market focused on U.S. durable goods orders. After the steepening of the yield curve yesterday, the curve should maintain its slope today due to a cap in the rise of shorter bonds as the Bank of Portugal was not expected to cut rates imminently, dealers said. ----------------------------------------------------------------
Note: YLDS3 is still calculated on basis of Feb 06 bond.
